section_4b_pre_print_debates.title: Inference Compute Hegemony: Can Cerebras Wafer-Scale Silicon Beat Nvidia Blackwell Clusters?
section_4b_pre_print_debates.consensus_view: Nvidia Blackwell (B200/GB200) retains GPU ecosystem lock-in via CUDA and NVLink switch fabric across hyperscalers.
section_4b_pre_print_debates.variant_perception: For token-generation inference latency, Cerebras WSE-3 achieves 10x-20x faster single-stream throughput by housing 44GB of on-chip SRAM with 21 Petabytes/sec bandwidth, completely bypassing memory wall bottlenecks.
section_4b_pre_print_debates.call_focus_question: CEO Andrew Feldman: How is Cerebras positioning its CS-3 inference cloud pricing against Nvidia B200 instances on AWS and OCI, and what percentage of enterprise inbound is seeking real-time voice and agentic speed advantages?

section_4b_pre_print_debates.title: Customer Concentration & G42 Revenue Trajectory
section_4b_pre_print_debates.consensus_view: High historical dependence on Abu Dhabi G42 Condor Galaxy supercomputing contracts creates regulatory and sovereign risk.
section_4b_pre_print_debates.variant_perception: Commercial customer diversification is accelerating rapidly with new hyperscaler and AI lab partnerships (including OpenAI high-speed inference contracts and AWS integrations), reducing G42 from >80% to under 50% of forward backlog.
section_4b_pre_print_debates.call_focus_question: CFO Tony Sacconaghi: Can you quantify the non-G42 percentage of remaining performance obligations and provide color on U.S. commercial enterprise pipeline conversion?

section_4b_pre_print_debates.title: Silicon Packaging & Foundry Capacity at TSMC
section_4b_pre_print_debates.consensus_view: Wafer-scale chips require an entire 300mm silicon wafer and proprietary packaging, making manufacturing fragile and supply-constrained.
section_4b_pre_print_debates.variant_perception: TSMC 5nm / 4nm wafer allocation and advanced packaging yields have matured significantly, enabling Cerebras to deliver CS-3 clusters on predictable 8-week lead times.
section_4b_pre_print_debates.call_focus_question: COO Gary Levitan: What are current delivery lead times for CS-3 clusters, and how is TSMC wafer allocation trending heading into 2027?
